description
May raise the outer-city quota of a settlement by one beyond the research limit (the more already won the lower the chance).
May raise the level cap of the chosen building by one (the higher the cap the lower the chance).
May add one building slot to an outer city (the more slots it has the lower the chance).

May raise how many resource fortresses you may found by one (the more already won the lower the chance).
May raise how many military fortresses you may found by one (the more already won the lower the chance).
Draw grain from the ever-normal granary: food for a settlement.
Timber purchased for the court: wood for a settlement.
Stone cut from the hills for building: stone for a settlement.
The year's iron tax from the mines: metal for a settlement.
A note worth a thousand strings of cash: currency for a settlement.
The Ministry of Works urges haste: the construction finishing soonest here, 15 minutes sooner.
The Ministry of Works urges haste: the construction finishing soonest here, 1 hour sooner.
The Ministry of Works urges haste: the construction finishing soonest here, 8 hours sooner.
A summons from the Bureau of Military Affairs: the training in the chosen barracks, 15 minutes sooner.
A summons from the Bureau of Military Affairs: the training in the chosen barracks, 1 hour sooner.
A summons from the Bureau of Military Affairs: the training in the chosen barracks, 8 hours sooner.
Hanlin scholars collate through the night: the research here, 15 minutes sooner.
Hanlin scholars collate through the night: the research here, 1 hour sooner.
Hanlin scholars collate through the night: the research here, 8 hours sooner.
Offerings to the gods of soil and grain: all production of a settlement +25% for 24 hours (another one adds 24 hours).
The finest salve for wounds: an injured hero is healed at once.
A veteran's notes from the march, scribbled by firelight: a hero gains 100 experience.
Torn pages, yet the essence of the art of war shows through: a hero gains 1,000 experience.

speed-ups: Complete Essentials of the Military Classics
heroes: Compiled by imperial order, the sum of military learning: a hero gains 10,000 experience.
Cleanse the marrow, be reborn: every free point a hero has spent comes back to spend again.
Broken pots and rusty blades: melt them down for 300 metal in a settlement.
An imperial call for worthy men and women: your hero limit rises by one, for good.
A red card with a new name on it, sent round to the household: a hero is known by the name you choose.
By decree the place takes a new name: rename a settlement (the first naming is free).
A gilt card asking a guest to the music house: one in four comes (sure by the fourth), and waits there as a candidate.
A fresh banner over the tavern door brings in other travellers: the tavern's candidates change now.
A notice on the academy wall calls other scholars: the academy's candidates change now.
Pull down and raise again elsewhere, brick by brick: move a building to an empty slot of the same district (its level goes with it).
Two works trade their ground: swap two buildings of the same district.
